next:wr:590.hint: あなたのコメントは的外れだと思う
next:wr:590.answer: I think your comment is off the point.
next:wr:590.fullSentence: I think your comment is off the point.
next:wr:590.explanation: be off the point『的外れである』。
next:wr:590.relatedInfo: on the point『的を射た』がその反対。

next:wr:592.hint: 看板には『芝生に入るな』と書いてあった
next:wr:592.answer: The sign said, "Keep off the lawn."
next:wr:592.fullSentence: The sign said, "Keep off the lawn."
next:wr:592.explanation: keep off the lawn『芝生に入るな』。
next:wr:592.relatedInfo: keep offは『触れない、近づかない』を表す。

next:wr:594.hint: より良い仕事を見つける目的で、彼女はその都市に引っ越した
next:wr:594.answer: She moved to the city with a view to finding a better job.
next:wr:594.fullSentence: She moved to the city with a view to finding a better job.
next:wr:594.explanation: with a view to doing『〜する目的で』。toの後は動名詞。
next:wr:594.relatedInfo: in order to doとほぼ同義だがやや堅い表現。

next:wr:596.hint: 予算に関しては、まだ何も決まっていない
next:wr:596.answer: In respect of the budget, no decision has been made.
next:wr:596.fullSentence: In respect of the budget, no decision has been made.
next:wr:596.explanation: in respect of A『Aに関して』。
next:wr:596.relatedInfo: with respect to Aとほぼ同義。

next:wr:598.hint: その公園は元市長に敬意を表して名付けられた
next:wr:598.answer: The park was named in honor of the former mayor.
next:wr:598.fullSentence: The park was named in honor of the former mayor.
next:wr:598.explanation: in honor of A『Aに敬意を表して、Aを祝して』。
next:wr:598.relatedInfo: 記念や祝賀の際によく使われる。

next:wr:600.hint: 費用の点では、この計画が最善だ
next:wr:600.answer: In terms of cost, this plan is the best.
next:wr:600.fullSentence: In terms of cost, this plan is the best.
next:wr:600.explanation: in terms of A『Aの点から、Aに関して』。
next:wr:600.relatedInfo: 特定の観点から物事を評価するときに使う。

next:wr:602.hint: 彼女はそのプロジェクト全体の責任を負っている
next:wr:602.answer: She is in charge of the whole project.
next:wr:602.fullSentence: She is in charge of the whole project.
next:wr:602.explanation: in charge of A『Aの世話をして、Aの責任を負っている』。
next:wr:602.relatedInfo: be in charge of Aは責任者であることを示す。

next:wr:604.hint: バターの代わりにマーガリンを使ってもいい
next:wr:604.answer: You can use margarine in place of butter.
next:wr:604.fullSentence: You can use margarine in place of butter.
next:wr:604.explanation: in place of A『Aの代わりに』。

next:wr:606.hint: これらの事実を踏まえると、計画を再考しなければならない
next:wr:606.answer: In light of these facts, we must reconsider our plan.
next:wr:606.fullSentence: In light of these facts, we must reconsider our plan.
next:wr:606.explanation: in (the) light of A『Aの観点から、Aを踏まえて』。
next:wr:606.relatedInfo: 新しい情報を踏まえて判断を見直す文脈でよく使う。

next:wr:608.hint: 昨年と比較して、売り上げは改善した
next:wr:608.answer: In comparison with last year, sales have improved.
next:wr:608.fullSentence: In comparison with last year, sales have improved.
next:wr:608.explanation: in comparison with A『Aと比較して』。
next:wr:608.relatedInfo: comparedとほぼ同じ意味で使う。

next:wr:610.hint: あなたの質問に関しては、確認してご連絡します
next:wr:610.answer: In regard to your question, I will check and get back to you.
next:wr:610.fullSentence: In regard to your question, I will check and get back to you.
next:wr:610.explanation: in regard to A『Aに関して』。
next:wr:610.relatedInfo: with regard to Aとも言う。

next:wr:612.hint: 彼らは自由のために戦った
next:wr:612.answer: They fought for the sake of freedom.
next:wr:612.fullSentence: They fought for the sake of freedom.
next:wr:612.explanation: for the sake of A『Aのために』。

next:wr:614.hint: 赤ちゃんを起こさないように、彼はささやいた
next:wr:614.answer: He whispered for fear of waking the baby.
next:wr:614.fullSentence: He whispered for fear of waking the baby.
next:wr:614.explanation: for fear of doing『〜しないように』。for fear of A『Aを恐れて』も同じ形。
next:wr:614.relatedInfo: for fear that S should doとほぼ同義。

next:wr:616.hint: 生存者たちは海のなすがままだった
next:wr:616.answer: The survivors were at the mercy of the sea.
next:wr:616.fullSentence: The survivors were at the mercy of the sea.
next:wr:616.explanation: at the mercy of A『Aのなすがままに』。
next:wr:616.relatedInfo: IMG_0722でも扱った表現の再確認。

next:wr:618.hint: 彼はすべてを失う危険を賭けて、貯金全てを投資した
next:wr:618.answer: He invested all his savings at the risk of losing everything.
next:wr:618.fullSentence: He invested all his savings at the risk of losing everything.
next:wr:618.explanation: at the risk of A『Aを賭けて、Aの危険を冒して』。
next:wr:618.relatedInfo: IMG_0722でも扱った表現の再確認。

next:wr:620.hint: 私を除いて全員が遅刻した
next:wr:620.explanation: A except B『AがBを除いて(Bは範囲外)』。
next:wr:620.relatedInfo: exceptは動詞の後に直接置ける。

next:wr:622.hint: 一人の会員を除いて全員が出席した
next:wr:622.answer: All were present save one member.
next:wr:622.fullSentence: All were present save one member.
next:wr:622.explanation: save ~『〜を除いて』。文語的な表現。
next:wr:622.relatedInfo: exceptとほぼ同義だがやや堅い。

next:wr:624.hint: 医者を除いて誰も真実を知らなかった
next:wr:624.answer: No one knew the truth other than the doctor.
next:wr:624.fullSentence: No one knew the truth other than the doctor.
next:wr:624.explanation: other than A『Aを除いて、A以外は』。

next:wr:626.hint: 日本に加えて、私は他の多くの国にも行ったことがある
next:wr:626.answer: Besides Japan, I have also been to a lot of countries.
next:wr:626.fullSentence: Besides Japan, I have also been to a lot of countries.
next:wr:626.explanation: besides『〜に加えて』。追加を表す前置詞。
next:wr:626.relatedInfo: beside(そばに)とスペルが似ているが意味が異なる。

next:wr:628.hint: 彼女は会議の間、彼のそばに座っていた
next:wr:628.answer: She sat beside him during the meeting.
next:wr:628.fullSentence: She sat beside him during the meeting.
next:wr:628.relatedInfo: besides(〜に加えて)とのスペルの違いに注意。

next:wr:630.hint: 彼女は友人たちの中で安心を感じた
next:wr:630.answer: She felt safe among her friends.
next:wr:630.fullSentence: She felt safe among her friends.
next:wr:630.explanation: among『〜の中で』。3つ以上のものの中にあることを表す。
next:wr:630.relatedInfo: betweenは主に2者、amongは3者以上に使う。

next:wr:632.hint: 騒音は別として、そのホテルは素晴らしかった
next:wr:632.answer: Apart from the noise, the hotel was excellent.
next:wr:632.fullSentence: Apart from the noise, the hotel was excellent.
next:wr:632.explanation: apart from A『Aは別として、Aを除けば』。

next:wr:634.hint: 会議は3時から5時まで行われる
next:wr:634.explanation: S+V+期間+from+起点+to+終点『主語+動詞+期間+起点のfrom+終点のto』の文構造。
next:wr:634.relatedInfo: fromとtoは対で使われることが多い。

next:wr:636.hint: 彼は明日から1週間旅行する予定だ
next:wr:636.answer: He will be traveling for a week from tomorrow.
next:wr:636.fullSentence: He will be traveling for a week from tomorrow.
next:wr:636.explanation: for a week from tomorrow『明日から1週間』。forは期間の長さを表す。
next:wr:636.relatedInfo: a week from today(特定の日)との違いに注意。

next:wr:638.hint: 犬はソファの後ろに隠れていた
next:wr:638.answer: The dog was hiding behind the sofa.
next:wr:638.fullSentence: The dog was hiding behind the sofa.
next:wr:638.relatedInfo: 位置だけでなく進捗の遅れも表せる。
